Team —

Attaching the first pass of messaging for the June reorg we discussed in leadership. This is intended for a company-wide note (leader-facing) plus a shorter version for managers to share in team meetings. Also included a separate doc with the QBR talking points so execs have consistent framing for customer or board conversations.

High-level:
- Why now: concentrating product teams around serving and runtime to accelerate production readiness and reduce handoffs.
- What changes: two people-manager changes (IC->manager promotions), consolidation of infra platform into Runtime org, temporary reassignments for a subset of research engineers to Dedicated/Optimize sprint.
- Timeline: announce June 1; manager sync June 2–3; one-on-ones June 4–8; public Q&A June 10.

Please review the attached: reorg_org_chart_v2.png (visual), QBR_talking_points_draft.docx (bullet talk track), OKR_impact_matrix.xlsx (what shifts against our current OKRs). Key asks:
1) Redline language in the doc or add comments in the Google Doc link below.
2) Confirm manager list for one-on-ones (I called out tentative names in the doc).
3) Any legal/security flags we should clear with Susan before announce (cc'd legal).

I want this note to be concise, empathetic on the people side, and explicit on how OKRs will be reprioritized. If we can lock wording by Monday EOD (May 18) I will route to comms and schedule the manager briefing.

Thanks —
Hannah
